title: web-chat public entry points as data (contract 12)
description: The package.json "exports" map web-chat adds, written as data so both repos can test against it: web-chat asserts that its package.json exports equal {subpath: target} over these entries and that every listed name exists on the module; ServerWebChat asserts it requires nothing outside them, by package name or by path into the dependency's directory (C-12.9). There is no root export and no "main" (C-12.7). At 826442d6 web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/package.json has "main": "lib/server/index.js" and no exports map, so every file under lib/ is reachable.

web_chat_version.description: The first web-chat version whose package.json carries this map (alpha.4, or earlier if the maintainer slots it).

everything_else_private.description: Always true: a path not listed is private and may change in any release (C-12.7). Node enforces it with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED.

entries.description: One row per exports subpath. No row may be the package root '.' (C-12.7, Q-12.5).

subpath.description: The exports key, as a consumer writes it after the package name (require('claude-web-chat/portal') has subpath './portal'). The root '.' is not allowed (entries refuses it). A trailing '/*' is a Node subpath pattern.

target.description: The file the subpath resolves to, relative to the package root, as written in the exports map. A pattern subpath has a pattern target.

kind.description: module: require() it and use the names. executable: resolve its path and spawn it with process.execPath; never require() it. metadata: read it (package.json).

stability.description: stable: before 0.9.0 a listed name changes only with a CHANGELOG Upgrading line and a hub window (C-12.10) that moves with it; from 0.9.0 on, only in a new minor version with a CHANGELOG line (C-12.8). provisional: may change in any prerelease before 1.0 with a CHANGELOG line.

names.description: The named exports that are public. A name the module exports but this list omits is private even though it is reachable. Empty for executable and metadata entries.

pending_names.description: Names promised for this module but not in it at the code baseline (826442d6): they land on the connector branch. Each joins names, with a changelog line in contract 12, in the release that carries it; until then web-chat's exports test skips it and ServerWebChat must not require it (C-12.7). Optional; absent means none.

purpose.description: What a consumer uses this entry for, in one sentence.

consumers.description: Who uses it: hub (ServerWebChat's runtime), hub-tests (ServerWebChat's suite), connector (web-chat's own connect command, for the record; it requires in-tree, so this never makes an entry public on its own).
